intro: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the Donkey App mobile app and the website DonkeyApp.com (together, "Donkey App", "we", "us"). By using Donkey App you agree to these Terms, our Community Guidelines and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use Donkey App.

sections.title: 1. Purpose of the platform
paragraphs: Donkey App is a platform where people can read, share, vote on and post jokes, memes and short videos. It exists for humour and entertainment.

sections.title: 2. Who can use Donkey App
paragraphs: You must be at least 13 years old to use Donkey App. If you are under 18, you must have permission from a parent or guardian.
You must be at least 18 years old to upload memes or videos.

sections.title: 3. Entertainment disclaimer
paragraphs: Content may include satire, exaggeration or controversial humour. All content is for entertainment only and is not factual, educational, political or professional advice.

Some people may find certain content offensive. Because of the nature of humour and user-generated content, we cannot prevent all content that may offend someone. If you are likely to be offended by humour, satire or controversial topics, you should not use the platform.

sections.title: 4. Your account
paragraphs: Some features, including uploading memes and videos, need an account. You are responsible for keeping your login secure and for everything posted through your account. Your profile details (name, picture, about me, links) must follow these Terms too.

sections.title: 5. Posting jokes
paragraphs: You can submit jokes with or without an account. Jokes are reviewed before they are published, and we may decline any joke without giving a reason.

sections.title: 6. Uploading memes and videos
paragraphs: Signed-in users aged 18 or over can upload memes (pictures) and short videos. Videos are shortened in size on your phone before upload and may be up to 90 seconds long.
Every upload is checked by hand by our team before it appears to other users. This can take some time, and we may decline any upload without giving a reason.

Trusted uploaders: we may choose to allow some uploaders, usually after confirming who they are, to publish without checking each upload first. Trusted uploaders must follow exactly the same rules. Their content can still be reported and removed, and we can withdraw trusted status at any time.
We may block any account from uploading if it breaks these Terms or the Community Guidelines.

sections.title: 7. Content that is not allowed
paragraphs: We have zero tolerance for objectionable content. You must not post jokes, memes, videos, descriptions or profile content that:
list: shows nudity or sexual activity, or is sexually explicit or sexually suggestive;
involves children in any sexual, harmful or exploitative way (we report this to the police and other authorities);
shows real violence, gore, cruelty to animals, self-harm or suicide, or encourages dangerous acts or challenges;
attacks or demeans people because of race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or age;
harasses, bullies, threatens or humiliates a real person, or shares someone's personal information;
shows an identifiable person who has not agreed to be filmed or photographed and posted, especially in a private situation;
uses material you do not own or have permission to use, such as clips from TV, films, music or other creators;
impersonates someone, or is a fake or altered image or video of a real person intended to mislead;
is illegal, promotes crime, terrorism, drugs or weapons, or breaks anyone's rights;
is spam, advertising, a scam or contains links to harmful software.
after: Saying it is "just a joke" does not make breaking these rules acceptable.

sections.title: 8. Your content and the permission you give us
paragraphs: You keep ownership of what you post. By posting it, you confirm that you created it or have every permission needed to post it, including the agreement of any identifiable person shown in it.

You give Donkey App a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to store, host, copy, display and distribute your content on Donkey App and to use it to promote Donkey App, including on social media. This includes making technical changes such as shrinking files, cropping, creating preview pictures and changing formats. Our service providers may process your content only so that we can run Donkey App.
You are responsible for your content. If content you post breaks these Terms or someone else's rights, you may be responsible for any loss this causes.

sections.title: 9. Removing your content
paragraphs: You can remove your content from your profile at any time. Jokes that are already popular may be kept on the platform without your name instead of being deleted. Copies may remain for a short time in backups or in other people's shared links or downloads, which we cannot control.

sections.title: 10. Reporting content, copyright and complaints
paragraphs: You can report any joke, meme or video using the report button. Reported content is reviewed and removed if it breaks these Terms or the Community Guidelines.

If you believe content uses your copyright or other rights without permission, contact us through the Contact Us page with: what the work is, where it appears on Donkey App, your contact details, and a statement that the information is accurate and you are the owner or authorised to act for them. We will remove infringing content and may close the accounts of repeat infringers.
If you disagree with a decision we made about your content or account, you can complain through the Contact Us page and we will review it.

sections.title: 11. Moderation and enforcement
paragraphs: We may review, refuse, remove or restrict any content, stop an account from uploading, withdraw trusted status, or suspend or close an account that breaks these Terms or misuses the platform. Where the law requires, we will report illegal content to the authorities.

sections.title: 12. Statistics and payments
paragraphs: Donkey App shows statistics such as views, votes and points so creators can see how their content performs. These numbers are estimates and may change or be corrected.

Donkey App does not currently pay users or creators for content, and nothing in these Terms or in any statistics, points or share shown in the app gives anyone a right to payment. We may introduce an optional creator revenue-sharing programme in the future. If we do, it will have its own separate terms that you would need to accept before taking part.

sections.title: 13. Sharing content
paragraphs: You may share content from Donkey App using the share options provided, for personal, non-commercial use. Automated scraping, bulk downloading or copying is not permitted.

sections.title: 14. Advertising
paragraphs: Donkey App shows advertising to support the platform.

sections.title: 15. Availability and changes to the service
paragraphs: We work to keep Donkey App running, but we do not promise it will always be available or free of errors. We may change, pause or stop features at any time.

sections.title: 16. Our responsibility to you
paragraphs: Donkey App is provided free of charge and "as is". Content is posted by users, and we are not responsible for it, though we act on reports and remove content that breaks our rules.

Nothing in these Terms limits our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that cannot be limited by law, and nothing affects your legal rights as a consumer.

sections.title: 17. Changes to these Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms from time to time. The date at the top shows the latest version. Where changes are significant we will let you know in the app or on the website. Continuing to use Donkey App after a change means you accept the updated Terms.

sections.title: 18. Law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. If you live in Scotland or Northern Ireland, you can also bring claims in your local courts. If you live elsewhere, you keep any protections your local consumer law gives you.

sections.title: 19. Contact us
paragraphs: If you have questions about these Terms, please use the Contact Us page in the app or on the website.
